extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create or find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for finding, creating, or troubleshooting a missing Wikipedia article title (searching for existing pages, account requirements, redirects, deletion checks, and using the article wizard).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly, log in or create an account and wait until it is autoconfirmed; alternatively use the article wizard to submit a draft for review or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Greg Giraldo death" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for alternative titles or spellings when searching so you do not recreate an existing article under a different name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can show whether the topic exists under a different name or is referenced elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article / submit a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not able to create a full article (e.g., due to account status or notability concerns), prepare a draft via the wizard or request that experienced editors create/review it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently created pages may be temporarily invisible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to force an update if you expect a newly created page should appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if the page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log to learn why a page was removed and whether recreation is appropriate or possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify capitalization variants and create redirects where appropriate to point users to the canonical title.
